subject: christian-religious-education
general_outcomes: By the end of Junior School, the learner should be able to:
demonstrate responsibility by conserving the environment as good stewards of God’s creation.
make use of acquired knowledge, skills, values, and attitudes to make informed moral decisions.
apply the teachings of Jesus Christ in their daily lives to promote social equality and responsibility.
take part in different activities both in the church and society as guided by the Word of God.
practice acquired moral values, skills and attitudes in their daily interactions to overcome the challenges they face as young people.
utilise ICT learning resources for the acquisition and application of knowledge in different learning contexts.

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to analyse the importance of learning Christian Religious Education.
assessment_rubric.exceeds: Analyses the importance of learning Christian Religious Education in details.
assessment_rubric.meets: Analyses the importance of learning Christian Religious Education.
assessment_rubric.approaches: Analyses the importance of learning Christian Religious Education but omits some details.
assessment_rubric.below: Analyses the importance of Christian Religious Education but omits major details.

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to compile five values needed to foster responsible living.

assessment_rubric.below: Compiles two to one value needed to foster responsible living.

substrands.name: Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education

Creative thinking: learners compose a poem on how Christian Religious Education promotes sound moral and religious values.
Self-awareness: learners write a personal reflection journal on how learning CRE has changed their behaviour.
links_to_other_areas: English: learners debate and discuss in groups.

substrands.name: Accounts of Creation

discuss the similarities and differences between the two accounts of creation
identify five attributes of God from the creation accounts

learning_experiences: name features found in the natural environment
take a nature walk and appreciate God’s creation in the school compound or the surrounding area

English: learners read Bible texts on the biblical accounts of creation.

Pre-technical Studies: learners conduct an online search using digital devices on the attributes of God.
